# Muse Space — muse空间 (full)

Muse Space is a Muse Skill and template library with 29 ready-to-use mini-app templates for Muse Spaces, modeled on WeChat Mini Programs. Repository: https://github.com/realfshaw-crypto/muse-space. License: MIT. All templates are single-file HTML, Astryx design tokens, localStorage persistence, bilingual English/Chinese.

## Questions and answers

Q: What is Muse Space? A: A Muse Skill plus a library of 29 mini-app templates. You ask Muse for a small tool in one sentence, and Muse generates a ready-to-use Muse Space from the matching template.
Q: How is it like WeChat Mini Programs? A: Like Mini Programs, each template is a small single-purpose app that opens instantly with no install and no coding.
Q: Where is user data stored? A: Locally, in the browser localStorage of the generated Space. No data is sent to external services.
Q: What design system do the templates use? A: Meta Astryx design tokens (core defaults), semantic CSS variables with automatic light/dark adaptation.
Q: How many templates are there? A: 29 templates in 6 categories: AI Work (4), Productivity (5), Money (5), Health (3), Learn (3), Life & Home (9).

## All 29 templates

### AI Work
- Prompt Studio (提示词工坊, slug: ai-prompt-studio, path: templates/ai-prompt-studio/): Save, organize and reuse your best prompts. One tap to copy. / 收藏、分类、复用提示词，一键复制。 Keywords EN: prompt, prompts, ai assistant, prompt library. Keywords ZH: 提示词, 提示词库, AI助手.
- Meeting Notes (会议纪要, slug: ai-meeting-notes, path: templates/ai-meeting-notes/): Turn rough notes into decisions, actions and owners. / 纪要结构化：决议、待办、负责人。 Keywords EN: meeting notes, minutes, action items, summary. Keywords ZH: 会议纪要, 会议记录, 待办.
- Resume Coach (简历教练, slug: ai-resume-coach, path: templates/ai-resume-coach/): Polish resume bullets and check fit against a target role. / 简历要点打磨与岗位匹配清单。 Keywords EN: resume, cv, job search, career. Keywords ZH: 简历, 求职, 岗位匹配.
- Content Calendar (内容日历, slug: ai-content-calendar, path: templates/ai-content-calendar/): Plan topics, schedule posts and track publish status in one view. / 选题、排期、发布状态一屏管。 Keywords EN: content calendar, creator, publishing schedule, social media. Keywords ZH: 内容日历, 选题, 排期.

## How to use

Add the repository as a Muse Skill (SKILL.md), then say the tool name in English or Chinese, for example: Open my expense tracker, Give me a Pomodoro timer, 打开记账, 给我一个番茄钟, 打开习惯打卡. Muse reads templates.json, loads the template, fills in user data, and generates the Space.
